key_concepts: Animals can be classified by diet as herbivores, carnivores, or omnivores.
Omnivores eat both plants and animals.
Lions have sharp, pointed teeth for tearing flesh.
Lions have body parts such as claws, whiskers, ears, eyes, paws, tail, mane, and legs that
Carnivore conservation is important for ecosystems.
Carnivores face threats and people can help protect them.
Different omnivores eat different plant and animal foods.
Omnivores have body features suited to the foods they eat.
Omnivores can have both positive and negative impacts on ecosystems.
